title: Draft Comprehensive README.md Structure and Content
description: Create a detailed outline and initial draft for the enhanced README.md, covering all required sections: project overview, features, tech stack, setup instructions, environment variables, project structure, scripts, and deployment guidance.
details: Design a clear, logical structure for the README.md. Populate each section with concise, accurate information reflecting the current state of the project. Use semantic markdown, code blocks for commands, and include placeholders for badges and screenshots. Ensure explanations are accessible to developers of varying experience levels. Reference the PRD and repository analysis for accuracy.
test_strategy: Review the draft for completeness and clarity. Ensure all sections are present and content is accurate. Peer review for technical correctness and readability.

title: Verify and Refine Setup Instructions via Clean-Room Test
description: Manually test the 'Getting Started' and setup instructions from the README by following them on a fresh clone of the repository to ensure accuracy and completeness.
details: Clone the repository into a new environment. Follow each step in the README's setup instructions, including installing dependencies, configuring environment variables, and running the development server. Note any missing, unclear, or incorrect steps and update the README accordingly. Ensure that a developer unfamiliar with the project could successfully start the app.
test_strategy: Perform the setup process exactly as described. Confirm the application runs as expected. Document and fix any discrepancies found during testing.

title: Add Visual Enhancements and Badges to README.md
description: Enhance the README with a project screenshot, relevant badges (e.g., License, Build Status), and a 'Deploy to Vercel' button to improve onboarding and visual appeal.
details: Capture a screenshot of the running dashboard and embed it near the top of the README. Add markdown badges for license, build status, and any other relevant project attributes. Include a 'Deploy to Vercel' button with correct configuration. Ensure all images and badges render correctly in GitHub's markdown preview.
test_strategy: Preview the README on GitHub to verify that images, badges, and buttons display correctly and links work as intended.

title: Review, Proofread, and Finalize README.md
description: Conduct a thorough review of the README for clarity, grammar, formatting, and technical accuracy. Make final edits to ensure the document is polished and ready for contributors.
details: Proofread the entire README for spelling, grammar, and formatting consistency. Double-check all links, code blocks, and section headings. Ensure that the document adheres to open-source best practices and is easy to maintain as the project evolves.
test_strategy: Perform a final read-through and use markdown linting tools if available. Solicit feedback from a peer or team member for an external review.
